actions.name: Use
actions.area: all living creatures within a 30-ft.-radius spread

description.summary: The caster emulates the frightful moan of a ghost
description.value: The caster emulates the frightful moan of a ghost. The caster emits a loud frightful moan and all living creatures within 30 feet must make a Will save or become panicked for 2d4 rounds. This is a sonic mind-affecting fear effect. A creature that successfully saves against the moan cannot be affected by the same spell for 24 hours. Learned From Ghost Family
